reader_summary.overview: Brad Jacobs is a career CEO and the founder of Jacobs Private Equity (his family office). Brad created and grew three platforms using a roll-up strategy that resulted in seven multibillion-dollar publicly traded companies. He and his teams have raised $30 billion of capital, completed 500 acquisitions, created hundreds of thousands of jobs.

key_points.text: He and his teams have raised $30 billion of capital, completed 500 acquisitions, created hundreds of thousands of jobs.
Brad shares his playbook in his aptly named book, How to Make a Few Billion Dollars .
In December, he announced a billion-dollar PIPE into a new platform opportunity, of which $900 million is his personal capital.
